notes:
Solo-performer recovery for the Lehigh Valley / Warren County crawl (census_lehigh.json; venues_lehigh.json was checked too, but its venue names, e.g. 'Musikfest 2026 (free stages)', are older, so every row uses census_lehigh.json spelling). Raw sources read: Explore Warren event pages (lehigh/ew_events.json, the parse of 562 event pages under lehigh/ew/ev), the Czig Meister Tribe feed (lehigh/cz.json, cz1.json), Funk/Illumination (lehigh/illum.json), the ArtsQuest events feed (aq/all.json, aq/desc.json), and the Musikfest 2025 and 2026 daily schedule PDFs (mfpdf/, mf25ok/; read through the earlier crawl's parse in master.json, cross-checked against the PDF text). The Godfrey Daniels and Easton Post / Live at the Falls entries in master.json were also read. Unusable: lehigh/ep1.json and sq.html (Cloudflare challenge pages), lehigh/tmp.html (WP Engine 404), lehigh/epw/test.html (Wayback offline page), msh.json (empty), the Jersey Girl calendar pages (navigation only, no events), gd/p*.json (REST API 401). Bonn Place (bonn.ics) and the Songkick-based venues (Lafayette Bar, The Funhouse, Allentown Brew Works) were not checked: Bonn Place isn't a census venue, and the Songkick pages aren't in the raw folders.
Qualifying rule: a solo row is kept when the same venue and date also lists a band or duo (from the census or the raw page), or when the venue is a festival or concert series. Treated as festivals or series: Musikfest 2025/2026 (including the Wind Creek Steel Stage headliners, since the census already lists that stage's Musikfest bands), Levitt Pavilion SteelStacks (free concert series), Lopatcong Music in the Park, Summer Music in Belvidere, Rock in the Red Barn, Sunset Serenades, Mohican Outdoor Center's Music on the Mountain (its July and August 2026 summer line-up pages are counted as that series), Rutherfurd Hall Jazz Series, Centenary Stage's Winter Thaw Music Festival, Sustainably Green Music & Arts Festival, and Living Spirits' Maifest day (that one also had a duo on the bill). Highmark Community Stage and Williams Brew Stage acts on 2026-07-17/18 (Blast Furnace Blues) and 2026-08-21/22 (CountryFest) fall on SteelStacks festival weekends. Most of them also share the date with a band.
Judgement calls: wineries, breweries and bars (Alba, Brook Hollow, Little Ridge, Villa Milagro, Williams Brew Stage, Roy's Hall) are treated as venues, not series. So a solo act there counts only on a day with a band or duo on the same page, e.g. an Alba afternoon trio plus an evening solo guitarist. Little Ridge calls its Saturdays a 'Summer Concert Series', but its solo-only dates were still left out. At Alba, Lorenzo Branca on 2025-08-23 played an evening solo set after his own trio's afternoon set; the row is kept. Paul Kopcienski on 2025-06-13 was left out because two Alba pages conflict about that slot (the other names the Corinne Mammana Duo). Acts left out as possibly groups: Twelve String, Bren, Just, Atlassian, LLW, ROSZE, Koyal, Maniya, Miss Olivia, Tourne, Ruby Dear, Zaire, Sol Katana, John DeRosa, Bobby Clark, Patrick Poladian (billed without 'Trio' once), Mari Byrd, Hector Rosado (leads an orchestra), KOSER and Doc Robinson (both described as bands), Kevin Kenny – The Chesney Show, Stacy Gabel: A Touch of Class, and every '& Friends' bill. Naked Jake (Lopatcong) is kept as solo, following the earlier crawl's judgement. Also left out: duos and co-bills of two solo artists (e.g. Bob Schneider & Steve Poltz, Patty Griffin & Kathleen Edwards, Antje Duvekot & Seth Glier at Godfrey Daniels), national-anthem singers, street performers, kids' and library programs (Richard Stillman, Patrick Kerssen at CDH Library), guest players billed 'with' a band (Chris Vitarello, Joe Cirotti), Chris Funk's magic show, DJs, open mics, jams, drag, comedy, and school or community groups. Godfrey Daniels produced no rows: its band nights have no second act, and its solo nights have no band. The Czig Meister solo afternoons (Madison Gerish, Jimmy Pink, Declan O'Hara and others) were never on band dates. Harvest & Hops (soloist Dakota Sean) was at Funk's Slatington site, not the Emmaus census venue, so it is left out. Names were normalised: 'Cathy Ritter Acoustic' to Cathy Ritter, 'DAN MIES on the Keys' to Dan Mies, 'Fabry Orihuela' to Fabricio Orihuela, 'Christina Coletti' (2026 Lyrikplatz) to Christina Giacoletti (same genre and stage, probably a typo), 'Stacey Gabel' to Stacy Gabel, and 'Kristen Morganstern' to Kristen Morgenstern. The billing field keeps the raw text. Only 8 of the 21 Musikfest 2025 daily PDFs exist, and the ArtsQuest feed starts 2025-09-11, so 2025 SteelStacks coverage is partial. Dates after 2026-10-26 are scheduled shows. band_info covers only acts whose listing gives a genre, hometown or description; Musikfest home_base is the hometown printed on the schedule.
